Slow Cooker Maple Pulled Pork
Submitted by maplekitchen_42 · ★★★★☆ (318 reviews)
Prep 15 mins | Cook 8-10 hrs on LOW | Serves 6-8

INGREDIENTS
1 pork shoulder roast (3 to 4 lbs)
1 T. chili powder
2 t. smoked paprika
1 t. salt
1/2 t. black pepper
1 large onion, sliced
1 bottle (18 oz) barbecue sauce
1/2 cup maple syrup (the real stuff!)
1/4 cup cider vinegar
Hamburger buns, for serving
Coleslaw (optional)

DIRECTIONS
1. Mix the chili powder, paprika, salt and pepper; rub all over the pork.
2. Lay the onion in the slow cooker and set the pork on top.
3. Whisk the barbecue sauce, syrup and vinegar; pour over.
4. Cook on LOW 8 to 10 hours or HIGH 5 to 6 hours, until it falls apart.
5. Shred with two forks and stir back into the sauce.
6. Pile onto buns and top with coleslaw.
